hook: Harvey's flood below them, and one cable holding them up.
narration: A Coast Guard rescue swimmer rode the cable up with a survivor holding on.
Hurricane Harvey had flooded Houston, and Air Station Houston crews flew into it.
Then they spotted people on a roof.
The flight mechanic guides the basket in by hand, because the pilots cannot see straight down.
One by one, the basket brought them up into the cabin.
outcome: The survivors rode out of the flood inside the helicopter.
title: Hoisted out of Harvey's flood in Houston
question_comment: Could you ride a cable up from a flooded roof?

facts.claim: Air Station Houston rescued Harvey victims
facts.source_quote: U.S. Coast Guard Air Station Houston works to rescue victims of the aftermath of Hurricane Harvey.
Coast Guard responds after Hurricane Harvey

description:
A U.S. Coast Guard Air Station Houston helicopter crew hoisted people out of the floodwater after Hurricane Harvey on Aug. 27, 2017.
